'''Pirlatapa''' is an extinct and poorly attested [[Australian Aboriginal languages|Australian Aboriginal language]], presumably of the [[Pama–Nyungan languages|Pama–Nyungan family]]. It may have been a dialect of [[Diyari language|Diyari]].
